levels_design_note: Engine v4's simulated league level with learned rates does not come from the 5-year as-of priors: the adapter sets each target to eL(P) x ML / base(P) and both eL and base scale with P, so the window cancels; the level comes from the learned model (window offset + year trend + fighter histories). A literal re-level of P to the eradrift trackers would add the trackers' lead over the window on top of the learned year trend: on 2019-2020 (post-hoc scaling of the comparator's means, development) it raised every stat's deviance (attempts factor 1.115, sig attempts deviance 50.41 -> 52.24). So the engine-level analogue was built: trailing trackers of log(actual / comparator-engine expectation) over fights strictly before the bout, eradrift's verified tracker settings, league-pooled (tools/v9_levels.js). Its pre-declared 2019-2020 keep rule (data/derived/v9/levels_select.json) dropped all five trackers (each raised its stat's deviance: sig attempts +0.175, sig landed +0.072, TD attempts +0.0027, control +0.196, KD +0.0025 per fighter-fight), so components.levels is OFF in the candidate.

checks.G1: year-level base-rate error falls (CI < 0 on 2021-23) for each of sig landed per 15, accuracy (sig landed / sig attempted), KD per 100 head landed, TD (landed) per 15, control per 15 and finish rate: statistic = mean over 2021, 2022, 2023 of |sim_year - actual_year| (evalv.js pooled ratios within each year), candidate minus cmp4; CI from 20,000 event-cluster resamples stratified by year (cards resampled within their year); pass iff the CI upper bound < 0 for ALL six (a marginal bound is decided by the normal bound mean + 1.96 x bootstrap sd)
checks.G2a: sig-landed deviance on 2021-23 improves: per-fight Poisson deviance of sig landed (mean of the two fighters), paired, CI upper < 0
checks.G2b: total stat deviance not worse: the mean relative 10-stat deviance (tools/v8_gate.py 'total': per fight the mean over the 10 stats of the deviance divided by cmp4's mean of that stat) paired difference CI upper <= +0.005 (+0.5% of level, the plan's 6.3 / 7.1 item 4 stat-line 'not worse' tolerance)
checks.G3: per-card stacks vs annual-static stacks: NOT APPLICABLE. v9's base (v4, the latest kept version) has no predict() package and no stack weight provider, and the verified calibration study (research/model_calib.md) found no per-card / recency scheme that beats the incumbents on the forward-chained 2021-23 gate; the component is not built
checks.G4: method-head offsets vs static intercepts: NOT APPLICABLE. The eradrift verifier did not adopt method-level offsets (nested forward-chained 2021-23 gate: 7-bin -0.00007 [-0.00167, +0.00144]), and v4 has no method head; the component is not built

checks.G6a: 5-round R4 KO-type hazard covers the real value: 95% event-cluster CI of (sim - actual) hazard of a KO/TKO (doctor / corner included) in round 4 among 5-round fights that reached round 4, 2019-2023, contains 0

RULES.bootstrap: 20,000 event-cluster resamples (card = event + date), seed 7; Monte Carlo SE of each bound (10 batches); a bound within 2 MC SE of its threshold is decided by the clustered normal bound (G1: mean + 1.96 x bootstrap sd)
RULES.descriptive_only: leave-one-out arms -judgeWF / -format and the +levels arm (every tracker on, as designed before the 2019-2020 choice) are scored the same way and reported; they cannot change the decision or re-enter v9

interpretations_set_before_the_binding_r: 'year-level base-rate error' = mean over the three years 2021, 2022, 2023 of |simulated - actual| of the year's pooled rate (tools/evalv.js definitions; accuracy = sig landed / sig attempted; TD per 15 = TD landed); 'falls (CI < 0)' = the paired candidate-minus-cmp4 difference's 95% upper bound < 0, for each of the six base rates the plan lists (all six must pass; none is relaxed because no adopted component targets it: the finish rate and KD per 100 head are expected to be hard, see expected_outcome)

'sig-landed deviance' = per-fight Poisson deviance of sig strikes landed (mean of the two fighters, simulated mean vs real total); 'total stat deviance not worse' = the 10-stat mean relative deviance with the plan's stat-line 'not worse' tolerance (CI upper <= +0.5% of level, 6.3 / 7.1 item 4)

'the drift rule fires' = switch events of rule 6.5.1 (b) as pre-registered (a one-way switch), on the stored 2015-2023 replay checks; this makes G5 pass by construction (research/model_calib.md says so); the number of quarters at which the trigger condition held and the number of separate episodes are reported next to it

'5-round R4 KO-type and R5 SUB hazard CIs cover the real values' = the event-cluster 95% CI of (simulated - actual) hazard contains 0, on the 2019-2023 five-round fights (the format pass was fit on these fights, so this check is in-sample; disclosed)

'doctor/corner <= 1.5x the 2019-23 rate' = simulated between-round stoppages per round-interval reached <= 1.5 x the actual 2019-2023 rate (point estimates, both formats pooled; actual = DOC, or KO/TKO at 5:00 of a round before the last)
G3 and G4 are not applicable (components not built, see excluded_parts_and_why); the gate passes iff every applicable check passes

binding scope 2021-2023 for G1, G2, G7 (the plan's confirmation years: choices were made on 2019-2020); 2019-2020 fights are simulated (the level trackers' history) and reported only through G6 and the descriptive arms
